text: This item was Deferred Indefinitely at the October 17, 2017 Meeting (Item TE27.62). This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to designate parking for a maximum period of 1 hour from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on Natalie Place (Colgate Avenue to Logan Avenue) in order to deter long term commuter parking and provide parking turnover.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of 1 hour from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north and east side of Natalie Place, between Colgate Avenue and Logan Avenue.
